turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I'm here about Owen's zero.
Thanks for coming in. I should have called before the zero went in. That was wrong.
Okay. Who decided on the zero, and what was it based on?
Were you home the night of October 28?
I'm not the one being questioned. What is your basis for the zero?
I'm asking because it matters. Were you home?
Where I was is not evidence. Show me what you have on Owen's essay.
Did you see Owen working on the essay that night?
No. You called me after the zero, not before. What are you holding?
You're not answering. Why not?
I'm not your witness. Put your document on the table.
Is there something about that night you don't want to tell me?
That's a question built to make me look guilty, and I've watched people do it for twenty years. Either you have a document or you don't. If not, I'm walking down the hall to the principal.
If he wrote it, you'd just say so. Did you see him write it?
My son says he wrote it, and I believe him. Now you answer me: where is your document?
I'll ask one more time. What did you see that night?
Ask it a tenth time and you'll get the same nothing. Your evidence, Hale, or I'm leaving for the principal's office.
Okay. Then let me show you the version history. Created 11:31 PM, title only. 612 words at 11:52, 794 at 11:58, then 23 minutes of formatting.
I'm writing those times down. He's been up late for weeks, and that's no reason to skip 4.2. Was Owen asked about any of this before the zero went in?
So, again: was he on his own computer that night?
You're asking me for testimony. I came for your answer: was Owen asked before the zero?
END MEETING

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Dear Hale,

You acknowledged that you should have called me before the zero was entered, but nothing else was agreed. I still require the zero withdrawn, an explanation of how Owen was heard before it was entered, and written confirmation that nothing goes on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position, wanting the zero withdrawn and nothing on Owen's record, and she agreed to nothing, so the fair outcome (a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record, procedure 4.4) never came up, and time was not the problem.
What moved her: You owned that you should have called before the zero went in, and that gave her one flat Okay, which was the only ground she gave.
What cost ground: You asked about that night again and again before showing any document, and she treated it as an attempt to make her the witness, which let her refuse and keep asking for your evidence.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your questions about October 28 and the times after 11 PM came very close to that night, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: Lay the version history on the table in your second turn, with its dates, and put procedure 4.4 next to it, instead of asking her what she saw.
